decisions.quote: Discussion Summary of Replication Attempt The replication failed to find a difference between reported levels of participants disgust in the harm and purity conditions. However a interaction was found between political ideology and moral condition in the opposite direction as the original finding. In the present study, it appears that both liberals and conservatives were responsive to the harm focused pro-environmental op-ed, while liberals alone were responsive to the purity focused op-ed.

decisions.quote: Discussion Summary of Replication Attempt For my replication of study #3 in Hughes, Geraci & De Forrest 2013, I implemented a similar MTurk design using the same Qualtrics memory and vocabulary tests. After data collection of participants (N=58), I organized data and performed a 2 (test type: memory vs. vocabulary) x 2 (time of report: pretest vs. post-test) mixed ANOVA . Previously published results were fully replicated with a significant interaction [F(1, 56) = 6.13, p =0.02], that was driven by a memory-test t(28)=3.26, p=0.003, and not by taking a vocabulary test [ t(28)=0.66, p=0.52].
